courses.title: Algebra & Number Sense
courses.summary: Linear relations and units, equations, inequalities, exponents, function notation, systems, and number sense — the highest-frequency ACT math skills.

skills.title: Linear Relations & Units
skills.key: Match every quantity to its unit rate. Convert mg to g before combining: $120\text{ mg}=0.12\text{ g}$. Days equal each total divided by its daily rate, then add.

skills.title: Number Properties & Divisibility
skills.key: A number is divisible by 3 exactly when its digit sum is. Bound digit puzzles first: if $A=(B+C)^2 \le 9$, then $B+C \le 3$.

skills.title: Custom Notation
skills.key: Treat a defined symbol as an equation. Unpack it, solve for the unknown, then evaluate what is asked — never the intermediate value.

skills.title: Solving Equations
skills.key: Undo operations in reverse order. Whatever you do to one side, do to the other until the variable stands alone.

skills.title: Solving Inequalities
skills.key: Solve like an equation — but flip the sign whenever you multiply or divide both sides by a negative.

skills.title: Exponents
skills.key: Same base multiply: add exponents. Coefficients multiply normally: $(2x^3)(3x^{-1})=6x^2$.

skills.title: Function Notation
skills.key: $f(4)$ means replace every $x$ with 4, then compute. Do not add the x's — evaluate the expression.

skills.title: Systems of Equations
skills.key: Add or subtract the equations to kill one variable. Adding $x+y=10$ and $x-y=4$ gives $2x=14$.

skills.title: Percentages
skills.key: Original = sale price $\div$ (1 $-$ discount rate). A 20% discount means you paid 80%: $\text{original}=48 \div 0.8$.

skills.title: Mean
skills.key: Total = average $\times$ count. Add the new score to the old total, then divide by the new count.

lesson.p: Most ACT algebra misses come from rushing, not hard math. Before computing, ask: what are the units, what is the unknown, and what form must the answer take?

list: Units first: $120\text{ mg} = 0.12\text{ g}$. Never add grams to milligrams.
Isolate the variable: undo $+,-,\times,\div$ in reverse order.
Inequalities: multiplying or dividing by a negative flips $<$ to $>$.

problems.statement: Abe takes a daily supplement of either only protein or only vitamins. His daily intake is $50\text{ g}$ of protein and $120\text{ mg}$ of vitamins. After $N$ days, his total protein intake is $P$ grams and his total vitamin intake is $V$ grams. Which equation relates $N$, $P$, and $V$?
problems.explain: Convert first: $120\text{ mg}=0.12\text{ g}$. Protein days equal $P/50$ and vitamin days equal $V/0.12=V\div\frac{12}{100}=\frac{100V}{12}$. Add them: $N=\frac{P}{50}+\frac{100V}{12}$. B forgets the mg-to-g conversion.

problems.statement: In the three-digit number $ABC$, where $A$, $B$, and $C$ are digits from 1 to 9, $A$ equals the square of the sum of $B$ and $C$. How many such three-digit numbers are divisible by 3?
problems.explain: $A=(B+C)^2\le 9$ forces $B+C=2$ or $3$. That gives $411$ (digit sum 6), $912$ (sum 12), and $921$ (sum 12) — all divisible by 3. Three numbers.

problems.statement: If the mixed number $Z\frac{2}{3}$ equals $\frac{8}{3}$, what is the value of $Z^2-3$?
A jacket costs $48$ dollars after a 20% discount. What was the original price in dollars?
If $3(x-2)+5=2x+1$, what is the value of $x$?
Which of the following is the solution set of $-2x+7<13$?
For all $x\neq 0$, $(2x^3)(3x^{-1})$ equals:
If $f(x)=x^2-3x+2$, what is $f(4)$?
If $x+y=10$ and $x-y=4$, what is the value of $y$?
The average of five test scores is $84$. If a sixth score of $96$ is added, what is the new average?
problems.explain: Old total is $5\cdot 84=420$. New total $420+96=516$ over 6 tests: $516\div 6=86$.

courses.title: Geometry & Trigonometry
courses.summary: Right triangles, SOHCAHTOA, radian measure, circles, slope, area, and similarity — diagram questions reward labeling before computing.

skills.title: Special Right Triangles
skills.key: 30-60-90 sides are $x$, $x\sqrt{3}$, $2x$ with the hypotenuse opposite 90°. Read which side is longest first.

skills.title: Radians & Degrees
skills.key: $180^\circ=\pi$ radians. Convert degrees before combining with radian terms.

skills.title: Circles
skills.key: $(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$ has center $(h,k)$ and radius $r$ — watch the signs.

skills.title: Slope & Perpendiculars
skills.key: Perpendicular slopes are opposite reciprocals: $\frac{3}{4}$ becomes $-\frac{4}{3}$.

skills.title: Midpoint
skills.key: Average the x-values and average the y-values: $\left(\frac{x_1+x_2}{2},\frac{y_1+y_2}{2}\right)$.

skills.title: Similar Triangles
skills.key: Same shape, scaled sides. Set a proportion: person over shadow equals tree over shadow.

lesson.p: On every diagram question, write the known sides, angles, and what is asked directly on the figure. Half of geometry errors are bookkeeping errors.

problems.statement: Which of the following equals $\frac{7\pi}{4}+\frac{4\pi}{3}-\frac{5\pi}{12}-180^\circ$?
Matt has a garden in the shape of a right triangle with one acute angle $30^\circ$. The longest side is $8\text{ m}$. What is the perimeter of the garden?
problems.explain: The hypotenuse is $8$, so the short leg is $4$ and the long leg is $4\sqrt{3}$. Perimeter: $8+4+4\sqrt{3}=12+4\sqrt{3}$ m.

problems.statement: In a right triangle, one acute angle measures $35^\circ$ and the side adjacent to it is $10$. Which is closest to the opposite side?
problems.explain: $\tan(35^\circ)=\frac{\text{opp}}{10}$, and $\tan(35^\circ)\approx 0.700$, so the opposite side is about $7.0$.

problems.statement: A line has slope $\frac{3}{4}$. What is the slope of a line perpendicular to it?
problems.explain: Perpendicular slopes are opposite reciprocals: flip $\frac{3}{4}$ and negate to get $-\frac{4}{3}$.

problems.statement: What is the center of the circle $(x+2)^2+(y-5)^2=36$?
problems.explain: Standard form $(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$ has center $(h,k)$. Here $h=-2$ and $k=5$, with radius $6$.

problems.statement: A trapezoid has bases $6$ and $10$ and height $4$. What is its area?
In a circle of radius $9$, what is the length of the arc cut off by an $80^\circ$ central angle?
A right triangle has one leg $6$ and hypotenuse $10$. What is the other leg?
What is the midpoint of the segment joining $(2,8)$ and $(6,2)$?
A $6$-foot person casts a $9$-foot shadow. At the same time, a tree casts a $27$-foot shadow. How tall is the tree, in feet?
